source.changes: ECN shares the flight recovery boundary with ACK queue pressure and loss, without requiring the queue predicate or waiting for a stale path RTT. Queue/loss behavior unchanged.

scope: Separate correctness fix for explicit ECN feedback, layered on the queued-loss flight fix. No changes to queue inference, rate estimator, FEC, or gain.

regression.before: After the actual ecnTracker validates capability with ten ECT(0) acknowledgements, one flight of 100 individually reported CE increases reduces 7.68 Mbps to the 0.96 Mbps minimum.
regression.after: The flight reduces once to 5.76 Mbps; old-flight late CE feedback cannot compound. New-flight CE still reduces without queue evidence or a stale path RTT delay. Packet-loss counters remain unchanged.
regression.tests: go test -race ./internal/congestion ./internal/ackhandler passed in isolated snapshot and main tree.

fixture.source_baseline: The same fixed flight image in both ECN-mark and clean cases.
fixture.ecn_cases: 45 s TCP through 50 Mbps / 20 ms RTT netem loss random 2% ecn in both directions, applied to ECT-capable outer UDP.
fixture.clean_cases: 30 s at identical rate/delay without loss or CE marking.
fixture.packet_evidence: 64-byte UDP header pcap on the isolated bridge. Marks are inspected in the IPv4 TOS ECN bits, and captures report zero kernel capture drops.
fixture.resources: Same one CPU/512 MiB/GOMAXPROCS=1/GOMEMLIMIT=192MiB and both socket/device GSO disabled as cellular controls.

interpretation: The confirmed repeated reduction bug is a recovery-semantics issue. In these real 2% CE trials ACK delivery samples replenished the baseline bandwidth estimate enough to sustain about 42 Mbps; results do not show a material throughput collapse from CE or prove a broad performance improvement. Small n=2 and rate-independent random CE are not a model of an operator AQM policy.
raw_artifacts: dist/stability-2026-10-03/qos-cellular (ignored local experiment snapshots, full iperf JSON, resource series and packet captures)
acceptance: Accepted explicit-CE recovery semantics after the real tracker regression, race suite, four ECN-mark trials and four clean trials. Per-capture CE fraction and zero capture drops are preserved in ecn-capture-summary.json.
